verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers free startup legal tools: a formation document generator, dilution and liquidation calculators, and guides. Nothing in the evidence describes user-defined rules, event triggers, or automated actions; the only cross-tool link is manually carrying pro forma results into another calculator. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface. Event-triggered automation is a plausible feature for a startup-legal tooling platform, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence it exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
